function.name: update_announcement
function.description: Modifies an existing announcement in a Google Classroom course stream (e.g. edit announcement text or publish a draft). Only provide fields that are being changed. Never invent announcement_id; call get_announcements first to find the target announcement.

course_id.description: The unique course identifier where the announcement is posted.

announcement_id.description: The unique identifier of the announcement to update. Must be obtained from get_announcements.

state.description: Updated publication state. Use 'PUBLISHED' to post a draft announcement to the class stream.
